g.text: Numpy network 8-64-64-6 (4 992 weights) trained on 20 000 synthetic 8-band pixels of six classes; 2 000 test pixels; 40 random trials per point (line: median; band:
10th-90th percentile). Flips land uniformly on all stored weight bits (biases protected). Range check: weights non-finite or > 2x the largest original weight are set to
zero. ECC: SEC-DED on 64-bit words, multi-bit words left uncorrected. Top axis: 7.6e-7 upsets per bit per day, measured in SRAM on LEO satellites.
